question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.

Her arguement was well-reasoned, but it contained a few misspellings.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arguement"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"argument"**.
 
• **"Arguement" (Incorrect)**: This is a misspelling of the word "argument".
 
• **"Argument" (Correct)** means a reason or set of reasons given to support or oppose an idea, action, or theory. (तर्क)
 
 
• **Example:** The lawyer presented a strong argument in favor of his client.
 
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** तर्क
 
• Misspelled word: **"arguement"** (अमान्य शब्द). This is not a recognized spelling in English.
 
• Correct word: **"argument"** (तर्क).
 
 
• **Example:** She had an argument with her friend over a misunderstanding.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Misspellings** (गलत वर्तनी): The act of spelling a word incorrectly.

 
 
• **Example:** The essay contained several misspellings, which lowered the student's grade.
 
 
 
• **Well-reasoned** (सुसंगत तर्क): Thought out and logically sound.
 
 
• **Example:** His well-reasoned argument convinced the jury of his innocence.
 
 
 
• **Contained** (शामिल): To have or hold something within.
 
 
• **Example:** The book contained valuable information on the history of art.
